workLog.action: Finding 1: close the maxNesting 20 fail-open in blank_code_block_lines.
workLog.result: Added MarkdownNestingError and a gated two-parse block-shape divergence check. Primary parse at maxNesting 20; when a token sits at the saturation level, re-parse at maxNesting times 2 and compare top-level BLOCK token shape; raise on divergence so the CLI exits 2 (incomplete scan), never 0. Rejected raising the limit because that moves the cliff, not removes it. Zero real-corpus cost: deepest block level in the 345-file tree is 9, below the 19 trigger.

patterns.pattern: Gated two-parse divergence check for parser nesting exhaustion.
patterns.context: markdown-it-py saturates token.level at maxNesting minus 1 for both legitimate deep content and truncated content, so a single parse cannot tell them apart.
patterns.application: Early-return when the deepest level is provably below the cliff; only then re-parse at double the limit and compare block-token shape; refuse on divergence.

patterns.pattern: Per-finding revert (mutant) table as test evidence.
patterns.context: A test that passes whether or not the fix is present proves nothing about the fix.
patterns.application: Revert each fix in isolation in-place, keep new symbols defined so collection works, re-run targeted tests, and require every evidence test to fail under its own revert.

avoidances.antipattern: Raising a parser nesting limit to make a deep example parse.
avoidances.consequence: Moves the silent-truncation cliff to a larger depth without removing it; the fail-open returns at the new limit.
avoidances.correction: Detect truncation and refuse the file with a nonzero exit instead of trusting a larger bound.

avoidances.antipattern: Reporting the offending-file count as though it were the scanned-file count.
avoidances.consequence: A zero-file scan reads identically to a healthy scan, so an empty or unreadable tree passes silently.
avoidances.correction: Track scanned and offending counts separately and refuse a zero-file scan.
